title: The Chess Trophy
scene: At 3:15 PM, the chess club trophy vanished. The club room was locked during the tournament from 3:00 to 3:30.

suspects.name: Emil Voss
suspects.testimony: I was at the front desk at 3:15, pairing players.
suspects.alibiProof: The pairing sheet shows Emil's writing at 3:14.

suspects.name: Freya Lund
suspects.testimony: I was playing board two at 3:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The board camera shows Freya moving a piece at 3:16.

suspects.name: Gus Ash
suspects.testimony: I was watching from the hallway at 3:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The hallway camera shows Gus at 3:12 and 3:22.

suspects.name: Hilda Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in my car at 3:15, counting entry fees.
suspects.contradiction: The car park camera shows Hilda's car absent, and trophy felt was on her coat.
